evidence_quotes.O: The Advents sounded muddy; the Sonys are so clear I am amazed. I can hear subtleties
evidence_quotes.C: I've been testing the ST800 headphones for a week now by listening through them for at least two hours a day to various sources
evidence_quotes.E: for my amateur purposes -- birdwatching with the Nikon and stargazing with the Celestron -- I am very pleased
evidence_quotes.A: I'm not knocking off any stars here because buying this cable - which I'm returning - was my mistake.
evidence_quotes.N: I figured that if one or the other was defective I could return it, or if I decided that I simply didn't want one I could return it
